title: Process Time Machine
summary: Replay eight actual synthetic quote exceptions through a deterministic baseline, early triage, and pooled pod. Inspect queues, unchanged-input rework, case timelines, utilization, adverse stress outcomes, and a bounded reversible pilot; modeled improvement is not realized savings.
limitations: All business data is SYNTHETIC; all arrival clocks, service durations, capacities and redesign effects are explicit uncalibrated assumptions.
The finite boundary ends at a pending handoff, not actual source correction, human approval, invoicing, payment or cash; two data holds and four review cases remain unresolved.
Eight authored quotes cannot estimate production variability or savings. Nearest-rank p95 is the maximum at n=8; the clean-case tail has n=2.
The pooled pod has five total service slots versus eight in baseline/triage, not an equal-staffing or cost comparison. Both improvements and adverse stress outcomes are reported.
No concurrency-safe credit reservation, real tax policy, enterprise integration, production data, deployment, native Hive activation, outreach or external mutation is implemented.
Browser rendering was not exercised; Node tests cover UI renderers, reducers and an injected DOM/clock adapter, not a visual, accessibility or cross-browser audit.
Plain ES modules require an owner-controlled local static preview; file:// may block modules or local fixture fetch. This project starts no server.
The reversible pilot and 35-minute rehearsal are proposals only. Human review, real-policy confirmation, adoption, actual business performance and realized savings are not observed.
